capture.manual_behavior: Manual pairing checks the selected image's signature through a temporary staging copy, adds full decode validation when optional ffmpeg is present, then makes the original path Noctalia's persisted wallpaper without retaining the staging copy. Use a durable file path that will remain available.
capture.none: No still has been exported yet.
capture.video_requirement: Configured-video export is deterministic and uses the optional ffmpeg command at the selected frame time. Without ffmpeg, only video and animated-image extraction is unavailable; static pairing and provider controls still work.
capture.w_engine_adapter_boundary: The cooperative W Engine adapter reports the active Workshop ID and owns rendered capture. After successful provider discovery, Wall-in-One sends wall-in-one-probe-v1; the adapter must re-send capabilities and current output state, or stale adapter flags clear after 10 seconds. Each capture request names a unique PNG under Wall-in-One's pluginDataDir()/staging directory, and the adapter must return exactly that requested path. Optional ffmpeg performs decode validation; without it Wall-in-One uses the Workshop source/preview fallback. Wall-in-One never reaches into provider-private state or signals the live renderer directly.
capture.w_engine_adapter_capture: W Engine adapter reports Workshop {id} on {output}; rendered capture is available when optional ffmpeg can decode-validate its PNG, otherwise export uses the source/preview fallback.
capture.w_engine_adapter_status: W Engine adapter reports Workshop {id} on {output}; capture is not advertised, so export uses the safe source/preview fallback.
capture.w_engine_fallback_boundary: Without a cooperative capture adapter, Wall-in-One does not claim to capture the live frame. It exports a real frame from Workshop video projects or copies the Workshop preview for scene/web projects.
capture.w_engine_unavailable: No cooperative W Engine status or numeric Workshop fallback is available. Configure a Workshop ID, select a static backing, or use configured-video export.

diagnostics.ownership: Noctalia owns persisted static wallpapers and color generation. W Engine and mpvpaper own live processes. Wall-in-One uses their documented panel/service IPC and never reads provider-private plugin state.

diagnostics.storage_ok: Schema-v1 config and schema-v2 runtime storage are healthy. Legacy schema-v1 runtime data is migrated atomically when loaded.

pairing.behavior: Pairing applies the exported still as Noctalia's persisted wallpaper, so the lock screen, overview/backdrop, compositor blur or xray integrations, theme generation, and wallpaper hooks have a real image while a live provider renders above it.
pairing.global_palette: Noctalia has one global palette. With multiple outputs, choose a palette leader or the most recently paired output determines the generated colors.
pairing.lockscreen_override: An explicit lock-screen wallpaper path overrides the paired Noctalia wallpaper. Clear or update that override in Noctalia if the lock screen does not follow the pair.
pairing.none: No static backing is recorded for {output}.
